items.title: EME Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Broad-Based Growth, Stock Up
items.summary: EMCOR's Q2 earnings and record revenues top estimates as broad-based growth, margin gains and record backlog fuel a higher 2026 outlook.

items.summary: Quanta beats Q2 estimates as Electric strength, record backlog and robust cash flow fuel a higher 2026 outlook.

items.title: CRH Stock Up on Q2 Earnings & Revenue Beat, Both Up Y/Y
items.summary: CRH's Q2 earnings and revenues beat estimates as pricing, acquisitions and infrastructure demand fuel growth, while subdued residential activity weighed on some segments.

items.title: Martin Marietta Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat on Shipment Growth
items.summary: MLM's Q2 results beat expectations as record aggregates shipments and infrastructure demand lift revenues and earnings, prompting a higher 2026 revenue outlook.

items.title: Masco's Q2 Earnings Beat on Tariff Refunds, Sales Miss, Stock Down
items.summary: MAS' Q2 earnings beat estimates as tariff refunds lift margins, but weaker North American volumes cause a sales miss and a 6.7% premarket drop.

items.title: Vulcan Materials Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Up
items.summary: VMC's second-quarter 2026 earnings and revenues beat estimates as pricing gains, higher aggregates volumes and cost control help offset energy inflation.

items.title: Orion Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates on Marine Project Delays, Stock Down
items.summary: ORN stock dips after Q2 earnings miss estimates as Marine project delays cut volumes, margins and guidance despite strong Concrete growth.

items.title: XPO (XPO) Appoints Michael Kneeland To Board As Governance Picture Evolves
items.summary: XPO (NYSE:XPO) has appointed Michael Kneeland to its board of directors. Kneeland brings leadership experience from United Rentals, GXO Logistics and Gildan Activewear. The appointment adds logistics and equipment rental expertise to XPO's boardroom. Investors watching XPO may see this board change as an important governance development.
